verses: (sari cheezen) jo aasmano aur zamin mein hain Allah Taalaa ki paki biyan kerti hain (jo) badshah nihayat pak (hai) ghalib o ba-hikmat hai

O hi hai jiss ney khuanda logon mein unn hi mein say aik rasool bheja jo unhen uss ki aayaten parh ker sunata hai aur unn ko pak kerta hai aur unhen kitab o hikmat sikhata hai. Yaqeenan yeh uss say pehlay khulli gumrahi mein thay
Aur doosron kay liye bhi unhen mein say jo abb tak unn say nahi milay. Aur o hi ghalib ba-hikmat hai
Yeh Allah ka fazal hai jissay chahaye apna fazal dey aur Allah Taalaa boht baray fazal ka malik hai

Jin logon ko Taurat per amal kerney ka hukum diya gaya phir unhon ney uss per amal nahi kiya unn ki misal uss gadhay ki si hai jo boht si kitaben laaday ho. Allah ki baaton ko jhutlanay walon ki bari buri misal hai aur Allah (aisay) zalim qom ko hidayat nahi deta
Keh dijiye kay aey yahudiyo! agar tumhara dawa hai kay tum Allah kay dost ho doosray logon kay siwa to tum maut ki tamanna kero agar tum sachay ho
Yeh kabhi bhi maut ki tamanna na keren gay ba-waja unn aemaal kay jo apney aagay apney hathon bhej rakhay hain aur Allah zalimon ko khoob janta hai

Keh dijiye! kay jiss maut say tum bhagtay phirtay ho woh to tumhen phonch ker rahey gi phir tum sab chupay khulay kay jannay walay (Allah) ki taraf lotaye jao gay aur woh tumhen tumharay kiye huye tamam kaam batla dey ga

Aey woh logo jo eman laye ho! jummay kay din namaz ki azan di jaye to tum Allah kay zikar ki taraf dor paro aur khareed khareed-o-farokht chor do. Yeh tumharay haq mein boht hi behtar hai agar tum jantay ho
Phir jab namaz ho chukay to zamin mein phel jao aur Allah ka fazal talash kero aur ba-kasrat Allah ka zikar kiya kero takay tum falah paalo

Aur jab koi soda biktay dekhen ya koi tamasha nazar aajaye to uss ki taraf dor jatay hain aur aap ko khara hi chor detay hain. Aap keh dijiye kay Allah kay pass jo hai woh khel aur tijarat say behtar hai. Aur Allah Taalaa behtareen rozi rasan hai
